Scientific question

How can galaxy surveys split into redshift slices improve CMB delensing?

Why it matters

Different observations contain complementary information about the matter that bends CMB light. Combining them can improve the recovery of a primordial signal.

My contribution

Developing a tomographic delensing workflow using LSST galaxy tracers and Simons Observatory CMB observations.

Methods & tools

Cross-correlations, tomographic galaxy bins, tracer weighting, simulations, and statistical inference.

Limitations & next steps

Assess sensitivity to photometric redshift uncertainty and galaxy bias modeling.
